name: Anako Shitsui
source:
Anako is the daughter of Tsuya Shitsui.
When she first meets Toma for the first time, she will not hesitate to call Toma' Papa' when Toma tells her that this mother is a very beautiful woman.
[spoiler]When Ana.ko learns that this mother wants to become Toma's girlfriend, she will do everything possible to support her by taking over Toma permanently so that no one can get their hands on him... Even during school hours[/spoiler]
